gloss: genuinely talented performer; person of real ability

definitions.gloss: person of genuine ability; talent-driven performer
definitions.explanation: Someone whose reputation rests on real skill rather than looks, popularity, or promotion. Used especially of singers, actors, and other performers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実力派|じつりょくは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a genuinely talented actor.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{実力派|じつりょくは}⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She grew from an idol into a singer of real ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実力派|じつりょくは}ぞろい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{下馬評|げばひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}した→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧。
examples.english: It was an unflashy team full of genuinely skilled players, and they overturned the predictions.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧ (real ability) plus 〜⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (type). Carries clear praise, often with an implied contrast against performers who sell on image.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力派|じつりょくは}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: accomplished actor
- {実力派|じつりょくは}⟦{揃|そろ}い→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: full of genuinely skilled people
- {実力派|じつりょくは}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be rated as truly capable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{演技派|えんぎは}→演技派：30339_engiha⟧: skilled at acting specifically — narrower than {実力派|じつりょくは}
- ⟦{個性派|こせいは}→個性派：30340_koseiha⟧: distinctive type — praised for uniqueness rather than technical skill
